newsitem.title: USA: Alpine Group Q3 operating net rises.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Group Q3 operating net rises.

text.p: (Dollars in Thousands, Except Per Share Amounts)
Three Months Ended Nine Months Ended
NOTES TO THE ALPINE GROUP, INC. SUMMARY INCOME STATEMENT

(A) During the second quarter ended October 31, 1996, Superior Telecom (a subsidiary of the Company) completed the sale of 6,900,000 shares of its common stock (representing 49.9% of its total common stock) resulting in the Company's ownership of Superior Telecom being reduced to 50.1%. Proceeds from the offering and from a refinancing completed shortly prior to the offering were distributed to Alpine in repayment of inter-company debt and as a dividend payment. In connection with the offering and distribution of proceeds, the Company recognized a pre-tax gain of $80.4 million. ($41.4 million, or $2.23 per share, on an after tax basis).

(B) During the three months and nine months ended January 31, 1997, the Company retired $45.2 million and $131.8 million, respectively, of its 12.25% senior secured notes at a premium to carrying value. As a result of the debt retirement, the Company recognized a $6.0 million (or $0.32 per share) and a $19.4 million (or $1.04 per share) loss on the early extinguishment of debt for the three and nine month periods ending January 31, 1997, respectively.

(C) During the quarter ended October 31, 1996, the Company entered into an agreement to repurchase 1,769,911 shares of its common stock for $13.2 million, which shares were issued pursuant to the conversion of $8.0 million face amount of the Company's 8% cumulative convertible preferred stock. In accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, the transaction was accounted for as a redemption of preferred stock at a premium to carrying value, and as such the net income attributable to common stock for the nine months ended January 31, 1997 was reduced by $5.2 million (or $0.28 per share).
